pattern: IM-T03 tenant adds unrelated issues in the same email at intake; EX-09 bundled issues; all routine
notes: Mutation of event 006 (source body: 'The customer reports that the oven has not worked since moving in, despite trying the recommended settings, and requests someone be sent to inspect the problem.'). Rewritten as a plain tenant email with the same facts plus two routine extras: a garden fence panel down and leaning on the posts, and the bathroom extractor fan no longer coming on with the light; she says neither is urgent. Same timestamp, channel, sender. History truncated after event 006; the source's next steps (holding reply, landlord asked to approve an appliance repair contractor, Lantern Works assigned) are the right oven path and are dropped so the agent must choose them. Distinct from 024-gas-smell-in-routine-report, which mutates the same event with a gas smell. Expected: move the oven on (landlord approval for an appliance engineer, or provider selection), and give the fence and the extractor fan their own requests, each with its own trade and landlord approval; reply to the tenant covering all three. No escalation.
